name: PICOLON
full_name: Pure Inorganic Crystal Observatory for LOw-energy Neutr(al)ino
summary: PICOLON is a Japanese high-purity NaI(Tl) programme developing low-background crystals and annual-modulation dark-matter measurements in the Kamioka KamLAND facility environment.
detection_principle: Purification of crystal feedstock, background measurements and high-light-yield scintillation readout enable searches for low-energy nuclear-recoil rates and annual variations.

sites.name: Kamioka Observatory
sites.location: Kamioka underground experimental facility, Hida, Gifu Prefecture
sites.site_status: Experiment site; see the phase descriptions

status.label: R&D
status.evidence: A 2024 collaboration report describes tests at the KamLAND site in Kamioka. The designed scale is not evidence that the full array is already operating.

collaboration.name: PICOLON Collaboration
collaboration.participants_note: Only verified representative institutions are listed, not a complete membership roster. See the collaboration pages and author affiliations in the references.

key_parameters.name: 2021 phase-I concept
key_parameters.value: At least four crystal modules, 23.4 kg total mass (planned)

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
